de.renewitt.mipet.subtitle: Dein kleiner Begleiter für iPhone und iPad.

de.renewitt.mipet.versionDescription: IPA neu verpackt: macOS-Metadatendateien entfernt, damit SideStore und AltStore das richtige App-Bundle erkennen. App-Version unverändert.

com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Install, sign and refresh your apps. Includes the optional integrated local tunnel. Apple signing profiles must authorize the capabilities of the app and its extensions; an external local VPN tunnel can be used when the integrated tunnel is unavailable. Based on SideStore and AltStore. Corresponding source: https://github.com/zynthec-dev/zloader-app/tree/dc743071c982859d88a87e032041b42885a48e55
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: All Apps overview for every source, pinned zLoader source with drag-and-drop ordering, Wireless IPA Installer with local HTTPS trust and transfer progress, modern tab icons and Sign App screen corrections.
